nodes.label: ADR-007: Trunk-Based Development with Path-Filtered CI
nodes.rationale: GitFlow's long-lived branches cause merge conflicts and overhead for a small team across four deployable services in one monorepo. Chose trunk-based development (short-lived 1-3 day branches merging directly to main) combined with GitHub Actions `paths:` filters so each service's CI only runs when its own files change, keeping main always deployable and CI time proportional to the diff. Trade-off: requires discipline to keep branches short; no feature-flag system yet exists for in-flight multi-PR work (tracked as backlog debt); emergency hotfixes follow the same branch->PR->main path, meaning all in-flight main work ships alongside a hotfix.
